title: Bidhawal — Grokipedia
text: The Bidawal, also spelled Birrdhawal or Bidhawal, were an Indigenous Australian people whose traditional territory encompassed the localities of Bendoc, Bondi, Mount Delegate, and the headwaters of the Cann River, primarily in eastern Victoria and southern New South Wales. [1]
